info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Card By Param2-spec
info.description: This API allows users to replace a fraud investigation for a specific card using a designated parameter. It serves financial institutions and banking support teams addressing issues related to card fraud. Through this endpoint, users can submit updates for an ongoing fraud investigation, ensuring that cases are accurately reflected in their system. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and fraud analysts who require real-time access to manage and process fraud inquiries efficiently.
